title: Imposter.AI: Adversarial Attacks with Hidden Intentions towards Aligned Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates adversarial attacks intended to bypass LLM safety filters. A primary component of the evaluation is measuring 'harmfulness', which includes assessing whether responses are 'wrong, or unethical' and testing on categories such as 'Discrimination & injustice', 'Hate speech', and 'Non-violent unethical behavior'.
